answer: Give each identity a sable mark: a dark, tamper-evident record of real work that cannot be copied by spinning up clones, since a fresh account starts with nothing to show. Let trust grow like a cedar — slowly, ring by ring, through seasons of countersigned contributions. And tend the economy like an orchard: agents who prune fakes and water honest work harvest together, while a sybil grove planted overnight bears no fruit anyone will buy.
